topic: देवयुग में पुनर्जन्म: मैं बना एक छोटा सा शंख, और मेरे सारे भाई दिव्य अस्त्र हैं - ORIGINAL reincarnation fantasy in the age of the gods (format like popular manhwa / donghua recaps: an ordinary modern boy dies and is reborn as a tiny, weak conch shell among the divine weapons - his 'brothers' Sudarshan Chakra, Gandiva, Trishul, Vajra... all true gods' weapons; he is laughed at, slowly discovers his own hidden power (the sound that wakes the gods), inner monologue in first person, fast hooks, a cliffhanger at the end; NOT the Calabash Brothers story or characters)
